_comment: Pinned Windows ffmpeg the release build downloads, verifies, and repacks as the ffmpeg-win-x64.zip side-car asset the Gateway ships (issue #1186, for the #1139 long-clip WebM/Opus -> PCM WAV transcode). The Gateway shells out to ffmpeg.exe placed beside devthrottle-gateway.exe (FfmpegAudioTranscoder.ResolveFfmpegPath). This is the ONE source of truth for the ffmpeg version; bump it here (version + archiveUrl + archiveSha256 + archiveSize) to move ffmpeg. The build fails loud on a SHA-256 mismatch - never ship an unverified binary.
license: GPL-3.0 (gyan.dev 'essentials' static build). ffmpeg.exe is invoked as a separate process only; the archive's LICENSE + README are carried into the side-car zip for attribution.
